verses.english: “These two don’t misrepresent the Realized One.

verses.pali: Yo ca neyyatthaṁ suttantaṁ neyyattho suttantoti dīpeti, yo ca nītatthaṁ suttantaṁ nītattho suttantoti dīpeti.
verses.english: One who explains a discourse in need of interpretation as a discourse in need of interpretation. And one who explains a discourse whose meaning is explicit as a discourse whose meaning is explicit.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṁ nābbhācikkhantī”ti.
verses.english: These two don’t misrepresent the Realized One.”
